physical_anchor: Manufactures electrical/electronic connectors, power-distribution components and sensors used in grid, data-center and EV power-management systems — a genuine physical connector/power-management maker.
value_chain_position: Power-management & connectivity component maker — sells connectors and sensors into grid power distribution, data-center and EV electrification build-out (the chain's 'power management & connectors' layer); the FMP 'Semiconductors' classification is a filing quirk, not TEL's real business.
